results.title: The Almost Perfect Murder
results.overview: Trinh, a viral TikToker known for her romantic content, wakes up on a cold film set with a splitting headache and amnesia, only to discover the body of Yến—an actress and romantic rival suspected of having a shady connection with Khang, Trinh’s fiancé. Đại, a detective hired by Trinh to investigate the suspected affair, sneaks in to help but accidentally leaves fingerprints on the corpse and is caught red-handed by security. From that moment on, this mismatched duo faces a series of bizarre predicaments: fleeing from police hot on their heels and a lurking assassin, all while bickering fiercely as they try to solve the case. Amidst the chaos, they inadvertently expose a shocking showbiz secret.

results.title: To Flourish
results.overview: After the loss of his best friend, Josh faces an encounter with Thalia in a dream

results.title: The Knock Shadow
results.overview: A young female therapist at a psychiatric ward in the ‘80s encounters a patient whose symptoms lead her to question what is real and what isn’t working in the field.

results.title: The Chase
results.overview: A middle-aged man who is in the habit of smoking begins to be confronted by the image of an elderly lady every time he does so; as the woman’s presence becomes more frequent, the smoker begins to rethink his habit.

results.title: The Sixty Year Mission: How Star Trek Changed Television and the World
results.original_title: The Sixty Year Mission: How Star Trek Changed Television and the World
results.overview: This epic documentary reveals how bold artistic choices, behind-the-scenes conflicts, and groundbreaking ideas came together to create an enduring television classic. Through exclusive interviews and never-before-seen archival materials, The Sixty-Year Mission uncovers that truth is indeed stranger than science-fiction.

results.title: Method to the Madness
results.overview: After winning a chance to honor her late basketball-star twin sister, an awkward woman hires an unconventional basketball coach to prepare for a high-stakes free throw. As training grows increasingly unpredictable, an unlikely friendship challenges both women to confront grief, self-doubt, and the courage to believe in themselves.

results.title: V/H/S/MIXTAPE
results.overview: V/H/S/MIXTAPE cranks the volume on horror with a blood-soaked collection of cursed music videos, terrifying performances, and found footage. Press play. Pray it stops.

results.title: Antrian Nomor Kematian
results.overview: Nur rushes her critically ill father to a referral hospital, only to find herself trapped in a grueling battle against rigid bureaucracy. Amidst this agonizing delay, her father's condition rapidly deteriorates.

results.title: Yorushika LIVE: "Tousaku"
results.overview: A concept live performance by n-buna, combining recitation and musical performance, held from September to October 2025.  This video features footage from Yorushika's LIVE TOUR 2025 "Plagiarism Re-enactment".

results.title: Some Detective
results.overview: Writer Hye-joo is trying her hand at a detective novel for the first time, but things aren’t going as she'd hoped. One day she receives a call from the mother of her ex-husband Tae-jae and sets out, beginning an unfamiliar journey. What follows is a series of encounters, some with people from Hye-joo's past and others arising from relationships in her present. These encounters may have little to do with her original purpose, taking her far off course. On a day she is supposed to meet her boyfriend, for instance, she never sees him and instead finds herself spending time with his son Yul-i and his friend Jong-i.

results.title: Not for You
results.overview: Eunwoo, Seungwoo, and Yunyoung met at a support group for survivors of suicide loss. Having each experienced the loss of someone close to them, they often spend time together. They visit the Hantan River together, where Seungwoo's late father's ashes were scattered, and help Yunyoung move into her first place of her own. It was those they lost who brought the three of them together.

results.title: Pirjo in Sweden
results.overview: When Pirjo Heikkilä embarrasses herself in public at a charity event, she begins to believe that she needs a change of scenery. Pirjo learns a surprising secret about her family that leads her to Sweden. Pirjo sets off on her journey convinced that her true life awaits her in Stockholm—surrounded by royalty, new friends, and greater human dignity. But the trip turns out to be anything but dignified. She faces one awkward situation after another and an endless need to appear more Swedish than she really is.

results.title: Mindshare: The Download
results.overview: After joining Mindshare, Evan begins experiencing vivid flashes of a life he doesn't remember. The company insists these are normal side effects of neural acclimation, but Evan soon discovers that his memories have been edited, replaced, and repurposed. As he uncovers the identity of the man whose memories he carries, Evan realizes he is living a borrowed life, and Mindshare will do anything to keep him from reclaiming his own.

results.title: Close
results.overview: Keane, nearing thirty, finds a box of his absent father’s negatives. He prints the images in a darkroom’s red glow. As he and his mother Diane look through distant exposures from the half-past, the prints expose a life that was always out of frame. Closure leads them back to the shoreline, where Keane reframes what remains.

results.title: Selvi
results.overview: After her best friend Kavitha’s sudden collapse, Selvi, a home care nurse, takes on her shifts in addition to her own, determined to hold everything together. Moving from one house to another, she spends her days caring for the elderly, rarely stopping to rest. As the long hours blur the boundaries between care and exhaustion, Selvi begins to confront the weight of guilt, love, and survival.

results.title: Vanishing Point
results.overview: Three urban explorers enter an abandoned office building in search of forgotten spaces, but as the layout shifts and reality frays, they find themselves trapped in a 'liminal' maze that quietly erases their sense of time, place and each other.

results.title: A Girl Called Alice
results.overview: In the middle of London's mobile phone theft epidemic; a young woman with the reputation of one of the most gifted phone thieves is challenged by a notorious street gang leader to see just how good she really is, but is it a wise choice?

results.title: Brotherhood: A Cinematic Musical
results.overview: "Brotherhood" tells the story of two next-door neighbors: Jon, a white US citizen, and Fabián, a Mexican immigrant who learn what it means to be American and to love your neighbor.

results.title: This Is How the World Ends
results.original_title: This Is How the World Ends
results.overview: When a war breaks out between humanity and the AI Machine States, the world is thrown into a state of confusion.
